cover.name: Lukas
cover.location: Originally from and living in Tönisvorst, Germany

education-and-career.title: Education & Career
education-and-career.text1: After completing my vocational diploma with a focus on electrical engineering, I studied business informatics.
education-and-career.text2: My professional career began with the functional support of software for designing target architectures. Later, I worked as a developer and consultant, focussing on the development of applications for managing key figures and reports for large enterprises. During this time, I gained extensive experience, particularly with technologies such as TypeScript, Angular and NestJS. Currently, I mainly focus on the design and operation of applications, particularly in Kubernetes environments. Additionally, I am a certified safety officer.
education-and-career.text3: I have a strong interest in developing and operating innovative and sustainable software solutions that strategically support businesses and create lasting value.
